cohort: 160 patients with third-/fourth-degree perineal tears who received a 12-week postpartum perineum consultation
finding: Perineal physiotherapy after third-/fourth-degree tears appears to contribute to symptom improvement, with most patients experiencing mild or no incontinence; however, the cesarean section rate in subsequent deliveries is higher than average.
mod_finding: Patients who had a cesarean section for their subsequent delivery reported significantly less urinary and anorectal incontinence compared to those who had a vaginal delivery.
